QUOTE: "Allow list** (`permissions.allow`) is the only thing that skips prompting." and "auto_ok = permissions.auto_approve OR ServerManager::is_explicitly_allowed (allow list)" under `check_approval (:161)`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the allow list skips prompting (suppresses approval) and ties it to check_approval in tool_executor.cpp, with is_explicitly_allowed in server_manager. It does not say "does not grant execution" in so many words, but the mechanism and location are there.
